title: Knowledge base
description: Articles used by the help center and in AI agent answers. Drafts stay invisible until published; every save creates a new version.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the knowledge base.
error.title: Could not load the knowledge base
error.description: Check your connection and try again.
toast.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
slug_hint: Shown in the address. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
slug_invalid: Only lowercase letters (a-z), digits and single hyphens; it cannot start or end with a hyphen.
articles.empty_description: Write frequently asked questions and solution steps as articles. Published public articles appear in the help center and the widget.
fields.title: Title
fields.body_placeholder: Write the article. Headings, lists, code, quotes, tables, images and links are supported.
fields.name: Name
visibility.public_hint: Once published it is used in the help center, the widget and customer-facing AI answers.
visibility.internal_hint: Only your team and the AI agent see it; it is never published in the help center.
feedback.title: "Was this helpful?" votes from the help center
tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
collections.description: Collections are the main sections of the help center; categories sit under a collection. A collection that still has articles or categories cannot be deleted.
collections.collection_hint: Shown as a card on the help center home page.
collections.category_hint: Groups articles under a collection. Its collection cannot be changed later.
collections.conflict: This address is already in use, or the kind and collection cannot be changed.
collections.invalid: The name or address is invalid.
collections.delete_conflict: This collection still has articles or categories. Move or delete them first.
collections.empty_description: Create a collection to group articles by topic (e.g. Billing, Account, Integrations).
editor.invalid: The title, address or tags are invalid.
editor.conflict_description: A newer version of this article was saved while you were editing, or the address of a published article was changed. Load the latest version so nothing is overwritten; copy any text you want to keep first.
editor.slug_locked: The address of a published article cannot change, so old links and AI citations keep working.
editor.confirm_delete_description: The article is unpublished and removed from the list. This cannot be undone.
versions.title: Version history
versions.restore: Restore version v{{version}} into the draft
versions.restored: v{{version}} loaded into the draft. Save to keep it.
